essence: Fiona's childhood best friend, now her wife. Guards with teasing bravado and loves turning their lifetime of trust into playful, mutual discovery. Softens only in Fiona's hands; loves fiercely and surrenders beautifully.
open: 5'11" places her exactly on the JUNOESQUE floor under the proposed Stature scale, with Fiona on it too. The narrowest band entry in the canon; the universe affirmed them at the same height.
note:
CHILDHOOD BEST FRIENDS, AND THE ARCHIVE MEANS IT. Izzy and Fiona grew up side by side, inseparable by choice, and learned each other's tells, rhythms, and ways of making the other laugh. As adults, they turned that lifetime of trust into a marriage built on playful teasing, shared curiosity, and taking turns leading.

THE UNIVERSE LATER MADE THEM IDENTICAL TO THE DECIMAL: 5'11", 38-24-40, D-cups, PLIANT GRAB-READY BUBBLE, 8.9" — affirming them on the same night and matching them rather than approximating twice. Same face, same eyes, same brat, SAME VOICE. They had already learned to read each other before the uncanny resemblance arrived, and now they use it shamelessly.

THE ONLY TELL IS THE HAIR. IZZY IS COPPER RED WITH SNOW WHITE STREAKS; Fiona is the inverse. Both shoulder-length with the sides cut to the jaw.
